frames.physical_state_en: Both man hands grasp the rigid push bar and pull toward him. Door stays closed, hinges fixed viewer-left; his feet and both adults remain inside.
frames.acting_en: Man's pinched brow and closed lips show effort directed at the rigid bar; heroine studies his pulling direction, not his face. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.

frames.physical_state_en: Man makes a second compact two-hand pull; the closed panel and bar stay rigid. Feet remain indoors and no one crosses the threshold.
frames.acting_en: One brief cheek puff accompanies the second compact tug; heroine's eyes move toward the bar's free end with a very small eyebrow lift. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.

frames.physical_state_en: Man has released the bar, hands withdrawn near chest, upright stance and one small indoor foot reposition complete. Heroine RIGHT palm approaches the moving bar near its free end.
frames.acting_en: Man watches her approaching RIGHT palm, hands already withdrawn; heroine focuses on the contact point with a neutral mouth. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.

frames.physical_state_en: Heroine RIGHT palm makes actual contact with the moving bar; outward opening has begun around the same viewer-left hinge. Both adults stay inside.
frames.acting_en: Heroine calmly watches the moving bar at contact; man notices the first outward movement with a small eyebrow release, no smile yet. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.

frames.physical_state_en: Same door is open roughly 45 degrees into the courtyard; heroine RIGHT palm still follows the bar at the free end. Feet stay inside; door arc is empty.
frames.acting_en: Man's eyes widen slightly at the open gap, not at the heroine; her expression stays focused while hand remains on the bar. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.

frames.physical_state_en: Door stays at the same open angle and heroine RIGHT hand has withdrawn. Free bottom corner is beyond the threshold outside; everyone remains indoors.
frames.acting_en: With the door held open and hand withdrawn, man glances from the clear opening down toward his own hands, beginning to understand. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.

frames.physical_state_en: Man inspects his own empty hands. Heroine hands rest loosely at her own waist; both keep feet planted indoors. Door remains open.
frames.acting_en: Man studies his own empty palms with dropped shoulders and a small embarrassed lip press; heroine holds a faint kind smile, hands at own waist. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.

frames.physical_state_en: Heroine joins two empty flat palms at lower sternum in one small forward bow. Door remains open; nobody crosses its panel or threshold.
frames.acting_en: Heroine performs the shallow small bow, eyes gently lowered; man settles his hands and expression, the open doorway remains the visual answer. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.
